## Upstream / 上游

Repository URL and a full commit, if known.

## Role and use / 职责与用途

Workflow, workbench, engine, library, or discovery directory? What request does it help with?

## Inputs, outputs, and requirements / 输入、输出与环境

## Source and license / 来源与许可

## Evidence / 已有验证

Which commands have you actually run, and what did they prove? It is fine to propose an untested tool; mark it as untested.
